धत्तूर: धत्तूर (1) DATURA STRAMONIUM LINN. (Bpn, p. 317-320; Chopra; DWH 2, p. 584-624; KB 3, p. 1784-1787; V 5, p. 93-94: कृष्णधत्तूर) = D. TATULA LINN. (Bpn, p. 317-320; Chopra); (2) D. METEL LINN. (Bpn, p. 317-320: कृष्णधत्तूर; Chopra: धुस्तूर; Dutt: धुस्तूर; DWH 2, p. 585-624; KB 3, p. 1791-1792: धुस्तूर; Vśs; Wise); (3) D. FASTUOSA LINN. (AFM 1, p. 61-64; Ainslie 1, p. 442: कृष्ण-; Chopra; Dgv, nr. 232: कृष्ण-; Dutt: धुस्तूर; DWH 2, p. 585-624; Dy, p. 626-629; HK; KB 3, p. 1788-1789: कृष्ण-; Nadk. 1, nr. 797: कृष्ण-; PW: कृष्ण-; V 5, p. 93-94: कृष्ण-; Vśs) = D. ALBA NEES (Dgv, nr. 232: श्वेत-; Dy, p. 626-629; HK; KB 3, p. 1790-1791: श्वेत-; MW; Nadk. 1, nr. 796: धुस्तूर; PW; V 5, p. 101: श्वेत-; Vśs) [= D. FASTUOSA LINN. VAR. ALBA C. B. CLARKE] (AFM 1, p. 61-64: श्वेत-; HK: श्वेत-; KB 3, p. 1790-1791: श्वेत-) (see Hooker 4, p. 243) = D. INNOXIA MILL. (Bpn, p. 317-320) = D. NILHUMMATU DUN. (Nadk. 1, nr. 796); there is no agreement about the nomenclature of the species of Datura: Hooker considers D. METEL LINN. and D. FASTUOSA LINN. as separate species (vol. 4, p. 242-243), as well as Cooke (vol. 2, p. 343-344), but a different classification is found in Chopra: a) D. INNOXIA MILL. is a separate species, b) D. METEL LINN. = D. FASTUOSA LINN. = D. ALBA NEES, and in IRM vol. 3, p. 14-15: a) D. INNOXIA MILL. = D. METEL AUCTT. (NON LINN.), b) D. METEL LINN. = D. FASTUOSA LINN. = D. ALBA NEES = D. FASTUOSA VAR. ALBA (NEES) C. B. CLARKE; IRM 3, p. 16-19: the names धत्तूर and धुस्तूर are applied to representatives of the genus Datura irrespective of the species.
धातकी: धातकी (1) WOODFORDIA FLORIBUNDA SALISB. = W. FRUTICOSA KURZ = W. TOMENTOSA BEDD. = GRISLEA TOMENTOSA BUCH.-HAM. = LY-THRUM FRUTICOSUM LINN.; (2) CALYCOPTERIS FLORIBUNDA LAM. (IRM 2, p. 23: श्वेतधातकी) = C. NUTANS KURZ (IRM 2, p. 23); (3) ANOGEISSUS LATIFOLIA WALL. (Avk).
धात्री: धात्री (1) = आमलक: PHYLLANTHUS EMBLICA LINN.; (2) = धातकी: WOODFORDIA FLORIBUNDA SALISB. = W. FRUTICOSA KURZ (KB 2, p. 1074-1076) = GRISLEA TOMENTOSA BUCH.-HAM. (Roxb., p. 317).
धान्यक: धान्यक CORIANDRUM SATIVUM LINN. (Ainslie 1, p. 91-92; Bpn, p. 34; Dgv, nr. 180; Dutt; Gul; HB; HK; Kav; KB 2, p. 1225-1227; MW; Na 1, nr. 257; Nadk. 1, nr. 679: PA 1, 9, p. 128-136; PW; Roxb., p. 272).
धव: dhava Anogeissus latifolia Wall. (HK; Na 1, nr. 208; Bpn, vaṭādivarga 60; Chopra; Bt.; Sharma; DWH 2, p. 12-13; Kai.Nigh., oṣadhivarga 837).
